name: protocol-to-tfl-modular
title: Protocol to TLFs - modular, team-owned sub-workflows
description: Take a study from its USDM study definition and SDTM to validated ADaM, ARD and rendered TLFs by running the team-owned sub-workflows in order, each as its own run with its own reviewers: tlf-planning (statistician) -> analysis-specification (statistician) -> cdisc-core-validation of the SDTM (standards reviewer) -> adam-core-loop: adam-derivation gated by CORE ADaMIG validation (ADaM programmer + standards reviewer) -> ard-tfl-generation (statistical programmer + statistician). The sub-workflows hand each other a study package of files by download URL; nothing is copied by hand. The AI writes plans, specs and code; scripts execute the code, validate, and produce every number; humans approve at every hand-off. Each sub-workflow also runs on its own, so a sponsor can adopt any one of them.
preamble: CDISC terms (USDM, SDTM, ADaM, ARS, ARD, TLF, CORE rule IDs, Define-XML, adverse events, deaths) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Optional study package { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] } with kinds usdm and sdtm (+ sdtm-define, sap). Leave empty: the statistician uploads the USDM, SDTM and define.xml in the planning run.

steps.name: Plan the TLFs
steps.description: Child run of tlf-planning: the AI plans every output from the USDM and checks feasibility against the SDTM; a gate checks every trace; an independent AI critic audits it; the statistician approves. Uploads happen here when no package was given.

steps.name: Specify the analyses
steps.description: Child run of analysis-specification: ARS-aligned analysis specs, the ADaM spec and an ARS ReportingEvent, gated against the ARS schema and every cross-reference; the statistician approves.

steps.name: Validate the SDTM with CORE
steps.description: Child run of cdisc-core-validation against SDTMIG: the standards reviewer records a disposition per finding; a 'fix' asks for corrected SDTM inside that run.

steps.name: Derive and validate ADaM
steps.description: Child run of adam-core-loop: adam-derivation (the AI writes traced programs, scripts run them) gated by CORE ADaMIG validation, looping on findings marked 'fix' (at most three derivation rounds).

steps.name: Generate ARD and TLFs
steps.description: Child run of ard-tfl-generation: the AI writes one program per output, scripts run them and reconcile every displayed number with the ARD; the reviewer approves in the TLF viewer.

steps.name: Assemble the deliverables
steps.description: Deterministic. Lists the deliverables of every sub-workflow (TLF viewer, ARD, ADaM define and lineage, CORE reports and dispositions, plan and specs) with the run that produced each, in manifest.json.

steps.name: TLF review asked for a spec change
A sub-workflow ended without a result
